stories.title: Kennedy Center board votes to close for renovations, add Trump's name back
new_facts: Kennedy Center board voted to add Trump's name to facade, circumventing judge's removal order, potentially setting new legal fight.
Inscription would read 'Restored and Renovated by President Donald [Trump]', placed beneath existing Kennedy Center signage; board also voted partial closure for two-year overhaul.
Center has until next week to present renovation and naming plan to the federal judge who blocked earlier efforts.
Leavitt departure comes less than 3 months before midterms; Trump approval hits record low per YouGov.
Renovation cost is $250 million; federal judge had temporarily blocked a similar closure three months ago.
stories.line: Kennedy Center board votes to close for renovations and reinscribe Trump's name on the building.

stories.title: Israeli forces order evacuations as settlers besiege West Bank village
new_facts: Israeli forces ordered Palestinian families in Qusra, West Bank, to evacuate their homes.

Israeli troops forced two families from homes in Qusra; seized eight more as barracks; former Israeli PM called it ethnic cleansing; top Israeli commander had promised to end settler campaign the day before.
Iran's central bank chief says Iran will join the BRICS New Development Bank amid ongoing US conflict.
One besieged Qusra home owned by a Palestinian American; US ambassador issued unusually sharp rebuke.
Israel simultaneously inaugurated a new emblematic settlement elsewhere in the West Bank.
US ambassador called the settler siege a "horrific act of terror" on the record.
stories.line: Israeli military orders Palestinian families to evacuate homes in West Bank village where settlers have besieged houses.

stories.title: CNN's Jennings emerges as candidate to replace Trump spokesperson Leavitt
new_facts: Natalie Harp, 35, Trump personal aide, emerges as long-shot press secretary candidate with 5% Kalshi odds.
DOJ memo extending executive privilege to 'private advisers' issued two days before Leavitt announced outside adviser role, raising questions about timing.
Scott Jennings now at 29% odds on Kalshi, up 24 percentage points in 24 hours, confirmed frontrunner.
Alina Habba and Stephen Miller named as additional candidates floated to replace Leavitt.
stories.line: CNN host Scott Jennings is being discussed as a potential replacement for Trump spokesperson Karoline Leavitt, who is departing soon.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Trump administration antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard
new_facts: Judge pauses Trump administration's suspension of LA homelessness funds, new story.
Federal judge dismisses Trump administration's antisemitism lawsuit against Harvard University.
Judge found most cited incidents predated the relevant period; Harvard moved to dismiss.
stories.line: A federal judge dismissed the Trump administration's lawsuit claiming Harvard failed to protect Jewish students from antisemitism.

stories.title: White House press secretary Leavitt to depart this month
new_facts: White House to host crypto and prediction market executives next Wednesday.
Leavitt's resignation left Trump with no plan to replace her; top officials will cover briefings in interim.

stories.line: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt is leaving her post this month; Trump has not named a successor.
